source: CBS (Aug 2025), Energieverbruik particuliere woningen naar woningkenmerken, 2019 t/m 2024 (ezk_profielen_2019-2024.xlsx), Tabel 6 (verslagjaar 2024, voorlopig). Temperature-corrected measured gas delivery.
method: Within-profile comparison: gas-heated dwellings (CV of blokverwarming) without solar PV, same construction period, floor area class, dwelling type and household size. Ratio of mean gas use of label group A/B and C/D to label group E/F/G, averaged over 17 profiles weighted by each profile's share of E/F/G dwellings.
label_groups_note: CBS only publishes label groups (A/B, C/D, E/F/G). Labels within a group get the group value. Because the A/B group also contains A-labelled dwellings, using it as the target for schillabel B slightly overstates savings.
co2_source: RVO, Nederlandse lijst energiedragers en standaard CO2-emissiefactoren (combustion factor)
caveat: Cross-sectional comparison of dwellings that differ in label, not before/after measurement of renovated dwellings. Actual renovation savings often fall short of expectations (van den Brom et al., 2019).
